commands.help: Lists directory contents; recursive listing is available on Windows only.
commands.long_help: On Windows, lists directory contents with sizes and modification times and supports local paths, drive letters, UNC paths, wildcards, and optional recursion. On Linux and macOS, lists names in one local directory only; wildcards, metadata, and recursion are not supported, and a nonzero subdirs argument is rejected. When the path is omitted, the current directory is used.

arguments.name: targetdir
arguments.desc: Directory or file path to list. Supports UNC paths (\\server\share) and wildcards. Default: current directory.
